messages.subject: Brookmere MSA - our counter (v3)
messages.plaintextBody:
Adam,

Following Thursday's call, our counter is attached (v3, tracked against v1 to show the net agreed position). Headlines:
- Liability cap: 150% of trailing 12-month fees (down from your 300%, up from our 100%) - this is Caspian's final position.
- Payment terms: 45 days, as you asked.
- Renewal notice: 90 days retained.
- Dataset: no accuracy warranty, but a new clause 9.2 obligation to correct material errors on notice, as the Customer's sole remedy.

If Brookmere can live with 150% I think we're done.

James

--
James Osei
Senior Associate, Commercial
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
